summary: Flathead NF tower near Bigfork, built 1932 as a 30-ft L-4 pole design; one source says destroyed 1957, another says removed with no year.

facts.design: 30-foot pole tower, recorded as an L-4 design
facts.status_note: One source says destroyed in 1957; another lists it only as removed, with no year given.

events.note: Destroyed 1957 according to firelookout.com; montanalookouts lists it only as removed, with no date

evidence.supports: built 1932 as a 30-foot pole L-4 tower; destroyed 1957
location about 15 miles east of Bigfork, Flathead County, Flathead National Forest
lists the tower as removed, with no year
Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks the tower as gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives destroyed in 1957; montanalookouts gives only removed, with no date. Both fit a tower that is gone, so the story reports both and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the 1932 build year and 1957 loss come from one page (firelookout.com). No staffing, fire history or present-day site description was found in two searches and the pages read, so none is in the story; the story is near the 120-word floor. Access left unset because no source describes the site today. No photos with a usable image address were found.
